== Possibly faulty data ==
The master-list cover says April 2013, while the inspected pages have 2014 footers. The provisional choice is to use that master as the later published source and leave the effective date of the complete text state unset. A cover date or archive capture date does not settle each field's effective date. <ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Players Committee virtual-card sheet], PDF page 9. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

The 29 January 2013 announcement dates the listed persona-name changes; it does not by itself date every lore or image difference. [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]. A dated original revision announcement or intermediate sheet would settle the remaining chronology.

== Separate published card versions ==
The original published version has its own full card article at [[IG Bodyguard Droid]], with original title, image and text and the original-state identifier <code>1273_6o</code>. [[IG-100 MagnaGuard]] retains <code>1273_6</code>. [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Publication history]] connects the articles and preserves the source evidence. This follows Bill’s clarification that a history section must not replace a published card-version article. The identifier documents the intended text state; this wiki edit does not claim a GEMP implementation or deployment.
